title: Startup checks
note: Proposed real readiness checks, not a timed progress animation.

title: Main / ready
note: Large target RPM, explicit source and surface speed; no suggestion of measured feedback.

title: Main / rotating
note: Running variant: calculated speed and elapsed time, fixed STOP position.

title: Navigation menu
note: Four clear destinations with fixed return to the main operating screen.

title: Run mode selection
note: Countdown is labelled as a delayed start rather than a timed-stop mode.

title: Jog / hold to move
note: Separated direction pads, slow speed control, prominent release-to-stop instruction.

title: Pulse setup
note: Readable timing blocks with an explanatory cycle preview.

title: Step setup
note: Angle presets and diameter remain visible; duration excludes acceleration.

title: Countdown / armed
note: Explicitly states that countdown starts continuous motion, not a timed stop.

title: Emergency stop / active
note: Blocking fault view; no start action and reset unavailable while input is active.

title: Emergency stop / reset allowed
note: Clear inputs permit reset to idle only, never automatic restart.

title: Confirmation dialog
note: Specific object and consequence; safe cancel action and labelled destructive action.

title: Program library
note: Select then review before running; edit is separate from start.

title: Program editor
note: Named program, explicit mode selection and a separate run-configuration editor.

title: Edit continuous program
note: Speed, direction, soft start and a proposed explicit automatic-stop setting.

title: Edit pulse program
note: All four editable pulse parameters with a derived total-time summary.

title: Edit step program
note: Six parameters at consistent touch sizes; summary explains repeat semantics.

title: Program library / empty
note: Purposeful empty state with one clear next action.

title: Settings hub
note: Six touch-sized destinations plus About; no tiny menu rows.

title: Motor configuration
note: Explicit physical DIP-switch match and stopped-motion apply semantics.

title: Pedal settings
note: Proposed release-to-arm and input-failure interlock; requires firmware changes.

title: Display settings
note: Quiet appearance controls; USB viewing distinguished from remote control.

title: Calibration / prepare
note: Guided workpiece calibration with diameter and speed visible before movement.

title: Calibration / verification
note: Measured angle, explicit tolerance and save gate; values are illustrative.

title: Input diagnostics
note: Human-readable signal states beside a timestamped event history.

title: System health
note: Illustrative runtime metrics; restart opens the confirmation screen.

title: About
note: Compact identity and useful hardware information, without competing with normal operation.

title: Numeric input
note: Full-size keypad, units, valid range and an explicit apply action.

title: Text input
note: Dedicated landscape keyboard with legible keycaps and a visible length limit.

title: Main / pedal fault
note: Proposed non-restarting input fault state with explicit re-arm instruction.
